title: 第11章 淬体丸从哪吃第12章 无妄之福喜从天降
content_zh:
自古以来，物以类聚人以群分！
这广明城，在大夏虽算不得什么底蕴深厚的古城，却依旧分出三教九流！
整座城分为东西南北中五区。
官宦巨富多居于歌舞升平的城中。
而略有家资的则住于繁荣的东区，此城以东为界，越往西治安越是混乱。
像是叶离居住的城南算是较为稳定的平民区。
最西边全是一群食不果腹的贫民和黑帮执掌，随时随地都可能爆发冲突和混乱。
当然，由于西边太过混乱，他从来都没有去过，都是从叔婶口中听来的。
但此刻，在叶离的眼中，这治安较为稳定的城南，四下也隐约可见衣衫褴褛的流民。
显然是由于帝国治下经济凋敝，加之入冬，西边的难民向着这里侵蚀。
‘必须尽快修行到入境了。’
想到冯教头所画的大饼，叶离心中越发急迫起来。
入境并不特殊，但若是在半年内入境，就可以一跃成为苍龙帮的核心骨干。
这个核心成员并非虚名，而是苍龙帮实实在在的培养。
每月有两枚淬体丸的修行资粮，还可以分到诸多店面地盘的管理费与管理十几个普通帮众当手下。
而这些被管理的帮众，就是帮内那些半年无法达到一境的同门。
这身份的转变，就犹如从贫农一跃成为地主老爷。
只是突破速度差出几日，地位便拉开天壤之别。
带着对未来的焦虑，叶离加快脚步埋头赶路。
一路上行人虽多，或有三三两两的流民，但他身着苍龙帮劲装，没有人不识趣地上来招惹。

待到离家渐近，邻人渐多。
一些妇人凑在一块聊天说地，望着从面前路过的叶离，欲言又止。
仅过去半月，叶离身材向上蹿了一寸，清瘦的体态愈发结实。
皮肤也从淡黄变得白净，脱胎换骨的变化让这些邻居不敢相认。
叶离也没有和这些人攀谈的想法，自得清闲默默赶路。
待到走远，那些邻居才迟疑地看向同伴道：“那是叶家小子吧，咋一月没见，变化忒大了些。”
身旁一人道：“之前宁秋不是说他觉醒绿色词条被招进苍龙帮了，大惊小怪什么。”
“我不是说这个，之前他没爹没娘的，和我家小王冲突被骂了，他以后万一富起来了，报复我……”
说话之人神态尴尬，让周围人脸上一僵，想起之前言传身教下闹出的矛盾。
但亦有几个不以为然地撇撇嘴道：
“怕个屁，不就是绿色词条进了苍龙帮而已，真以为能上的了天啊！”
“就是，我家那小子四个月前也入了帮，今天也该回来了，那孩子虽然词条差点，但从小肯吃苦，不比某些绿词条差！”
“就是，到时候问问那江家小子在帮内什么情况，说不定还不如我家！”
……
一路无话，行色匆匆间家中小院已在眼前。
叶离脚步并未停顿，提高声量道：“阿婶，我回来了！”
“离儿回来了……？”院内听到呼唤，一妇人奔出门来。
但宁秋欢喜的神情见到叶离的脸时却微微一愣，显然对他这一月的变化感到惊奇。
“是啊，月末通过帮内考核，回来休息一天。”
叶离笑容爽朗道：“我这个月在帮里表现很好，教头说再过几个月就可以当核心骨干了。”

话语消解了一月未见的生疏，宁秋欣慰地按着侄儿的肩膀：“好啊，生的壮实！有力气！”
“你现在还在长身体，中午阿婶再给你炖只鸡补补身体！”
content_en:
Since ancient times, birds of a feather flock together!
Although this Guangming City is not an ancient city with profound heritage in Daxia, it is still divided into three religions and nine streams!
The whole city is divided into five districts: east, west, south, north and middle.
Most of the wealthy officials and officials lived in the city where singing and dancing flourished.
Those with a little wealth live in the prosperous East District. The city is bounded by the east, and the further west it becomes, the more chaotic the public security becomes.
For example, the south of the city where Ye Li lives is considered a relatively stable civilian area.
The far west is controlled by a group of hungry poor people and gangs, and conflicts and chaos may break out at any time.
Of course, because the west side is too chaotic, he has never been there. He only heard about it from his uncle and aunt.
But at this moment, in Ye Li's eyes, in the south of the city where security was relatively stable, ragged refugees could be seen vaguely everywhere.
Apparently due to the economic downturn under the empire and the onset of winter, refugees from the west eroded here.
‘We must practice as soon as possible to enter the country. ’
Thinking of the pie painted by Coach Feng, Ye Li became more and more anxious.
Entry is not special, but if you enter within half a year, you can become the core backbone of the Canglong Gang.
This core member is not in vain, but has been truly cultivated by the Canglong Gang.
With two body-tempering pills for training every month, you can also share the management fees of many store sites and manage a dozen general gang members as subordinates.
And these managed gang members are those members of the gang who cannot reach the first level in half a year.
This change of identity is like leaping from a poor peasant to a landlord.
Just a few days difference in breakthrough speed makes a huge difference in status.
With anxiety about the future, Ye Li quickened his pace and hurried on.
Although there were many pedestrians along the way, or some refugees in twos and threes, he was dressed in the Canglong Gang's best attire, and no one came up to provoke him without the sense of humor.
As we get closer to home, there are more and more neighbors.
Some women gathered together to chat, looking at Ye Li passing by, hesitating to speak.
Only half a month has passed, and Ye Li's figure has jumped up an inch, and his lean body has become stronger.
The skin also changed from pale yellow to white, and the transformation made these neighbors afraid to recognize her.
Ye Li had no intention of talking to these people and walked on in silence.
When they were far away, the neighbors looked at their companions hesitantly and said, "That's the boy from the Ye family. I haven't seen him in a month. He has changed a lot."
A person next to him said: "Didn't Ning Qiu say before that he had awakened the green entry and was recruited into the Canglong Gang? What's the fuss about?"
"That's not what I'm talking about. He had no father or mother before, and he was scolded for his conflict with my little Wang. If he gets rich in the future, he will take revenge on me..."
The speaker's expression was awkward, causing the faces of those around him to freeze, recalling the previous conflicts that had arisen due to his words and deeds.
But there were also a few who curled their lips in disapproval and said:
"I'm so scared. It's just the green entry that joined the Canglong Gang. I really thought I would be able to get into it!"
"That's right, my kid also joined a gang four months ago, and he should be back today. Although that kid has a bad entry, he has been willing to endure hardship since he was a child, and he is no worse than some green entries!"
"That's right, when the time comes, ask that boy from the Jiang family how he is doing in the gang. He might not be as good as my family!"
…
There were no words along the way, and the small courtyard of the house was already in front of me as we walked in a hurry.
Ye Li didn't stop, and raised his voice: "Auntie, I'm back!"
"Li'er is back...?" The call was heard in the courtyard, and a woman rushed out.
But Ning Qiu was slightly startled when she saw Ye Li's face with a happy expression, obviously surprised by his changes in this month.
"Yes, I will pass the gang assessment at the end of the month and come back to rest for a day."
Ye Li smiled brightly and said: "I have performed very well in the gang this month. The coach said that I can become the core member in a few months."
The words dispelled the unfamiliarity of not seeing each other for a month, and Ning Qiu pressed her nephew's shoulder happily: "Okay, you are strong! You have strength!"
"You are still growing. Auntie will give it to you at noon.Stew chicken to replenish your body! "
